claims.statement: The README's gpuix gaps section is the authoritative list of gpuix bugs and missing features the port works around, each with the components it hits and the workaround.
Without CSS transforms, popups keep an opacity fade and slide but lose the scaleY entrance, and glyph turns are swapped or redrawn.

Because gpuix #46 still makes a frame's cost scale with clipped, off-screen content, the port hides regions far from the page scroller with display none through src/lib/cull.ts; this is a kept workaround: the removal comparison re-run on gpuix poc b03d4e27 and headless on 196d69ce favoured culling on every page that moved, and an observer-toggled contentVisibility 'hidden' variant on gpuix e591681e (round 16) lost to it on entry layout passes, forced reads and bento layout.
The app frame's title bar is a window drag region via appRegion drag.
On Windows and Linux, preventDefault on mousedown arrives after native focus has moved, so a press on a command-menu tab still blurs the field; macOS applies it.

Popups are content-sized with the trigger's width as a minimum, and a vertical-only ScrollArea lets a consumer override its content box through contentStyle, which SidebarContent uses to keep labels truncating.
The theme cross-fade is a transient UniversalStyle layer in src/lib/theme-fade.tsx.
scripts/drift-counts.ts prints the README drift-count table from the drift files by counting sections that have a Cause line.
Table is a display: table inside a block wrapper holding the fluid highlight, with header, body and row parts as table-row-group and table-row display values, so columns size to content.
StableLabel is a real inline-grid whose hidden normal and semibold copies and visible copy share one grid cell, so it wraps like the source, with nowrap and truncate opt-in.

App wraps the window in a full-size container named viewport (containerType inline-size), and the home bento grid's 768px and 1280px breakpoints are @container blocks querying it, since gpuix has no media queries.
gpuix paints an outline only when it has an outlineStyle, so every outlineWidth and outlineColor pair, such as focusRing, sets outlineStyle solid.

A label that clips with overflow hidden trims to cap height through clippedCapTrim, which adds equal padding and negative margins because the clip box is the trimmed box and would otherwise shave ascenders and descenders.
The slider's comfortable layers and compact step dots are calc() motion-value strings of the row's own width, so none reads a measured width.
The tabs-subtle label animates to and from width auto with no snap or remeasure step, because gpuix starts a width auto animation at the style change.
The thinking-steps screenshot scenario reveals the target card before centring on it, because a card far below the window is culled and has no bounds to centre on.

Removing the changelog's width 100% column wrappers after gpuix #36 made nested flex layout linear measured no change on poc e5231304 (changelog sweep draw p95 10.9 to 11.0 ms, idle CPU 58.8 to 57.6%).

The same viewport container in App carries lineHeight 1.5, mirroring Tailwind preflight's html rule, because gpuix e5231304 lays out text with no line height at the font's own metrics; unset text and form controls inherit it.
Input fields take the source's line height instead of a fixed height; the command-menu field uses FIELD (14/24) and FIELD_COMPACT (13/20) so its box is its line, and check-command-menu asserts both.
check-kit renders a bare view under test inside a display:contents box with lineHeight 1.5, because only App carries the root line height.

Before gpuix 83bab5a7 a motion value's animation had only stop, cancel and complete (getAnimations covers CSS animation and transition runs only), so pausing a native loop was stop() followed by a new animate() from the current value; now animate() returns playback controls and the README's pause row is gone. background-position is still not animatable, so the thinking-indicator shimmer is per-letter colour keyframes.
The README's gpuix gaps table now lists only thinking-steps as needing the shared setInterval frame clock because gpuix has no requestAnimationFrame.

Since gpuix poc b03d4e27, getBoundingClientRect, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver and onLayout return fractional 1/64 px values like Chrome (client* and scroll* stay integers), and since 83bab5a7 an authored inset, padding or size keeps its fraction instead of rounding to a device pixel; the fluid highlight still rounds rects, now only to match the source's integer offset* reads.

A long page's first draw still builds, lays out and shapes every node because nothing marks a region far before an IntersectionObserver reports against a first layout; gpuix 511bebab's shape store fixed the revisit half (shapes per revisit 215 to 8-12 on Changelog, 291 to 4 on Showcase, 142 to 0 on Command Menu) and the port has no workaround beyond deferring the release spy's first reading. The Command Menu's 340-440 ms mount JS was not part of that and not steady state: it came from each menu's first scrollTop write, removed by 704af9e5.
scripts/perf-page-switch.tsx is the headless harness for page-switch hitches, listed in the README's harness notes beside the real-window scripts/perf.tsx.

gpuix 83bab5a7 resolves a motion-value animation's finished promise only when it finishes or completes, never on stop() or replacement, so carousel-dots dropped its current flag and fill-reached-1 guard.

Before gpuix 8352e66c an atomic inline (the tabs-subtle inline-grid label) sat at a whole device pixel, so its baseline could be up to 0.45px off Chrome's; since 8352e66c it keeps its fractional origin, the label's baseline is exactly Chrome's (check tolerance 0.01), and the remaining residue is the cap height read as 0.704em where Chrome has 0.727em, with the port keeping the source's 16px/24px strut block.

In gpuix a looping native animation used to cost the whole page per tick (one looping colour keyframe on one text took 7 ms a tick on 3000 nodes and about 60 ms on 12000), so a page with a running loop idles at 37-45% CPU; since 196d69ce a paint-only tick (colour, opacity, SVG stroke dash or shape) is patched in its own unit of at most 256 elements, while layout loops (width, top) remain whole frames.

On gpuix 196d69ce an input or textarea anywhere on the page, even unfocused or culled, made every tick of a loop elsewhere Unsteady and drawn whole; gpuix c6475390 (#74) retains the editor so an unfocused input no longer does. The port did not work around it because the inputs are the source's own; it hit button, queued-stack and showcase.

On gpuix 196d69ce a loop in a descendant of a relative, absolute or opacity-below-1 box was declined as UnknownUnit on every tick, and an animated element that was itself absolute recorded no decline at all; this hit the button's press surface, spinner wrapper and inert opacity and file-thumbnail's spinner overlay. gpuix c6475390 (#75) patches these.

ThinkingIndicator stacks its words in one cell of a position-less grid slot, which with the word positioned only while it rolled (cc294fcf) turned its page from every shimmer tick drawn whole into about 62 patched ticks a second; since gpuix c6475390 the word is always position: relative and its shimmer still patches. thinking-steps' step wrapper dropped an anchorless position: relative (96f4e653).

gpuix f7b62f11 closed the font-smoothing gap (WebkitFontSmoothing 'antialiased' is an inherited style key), so the app's root viewport sets it once and the 9-42% heavier-text drift entry and README Bugs row were removed, taking the drift total from 541 to 540.

After gpuix f7b62f11 made the scrollTop setter lay out only what is pending, the command menu list and the page-switch reset write scrollTop directly again (the renderer.scrollTo workaround was reverted), and check-command-menu bounds a drain at one layout pass.

The README names gpuix poc 6f2a72d3 (zed bf26cbb68a) as the minimum fork, and its closed-gap list counts an atomic inline at its fractional origin, a forced layout that delivers no onLayout or ResizeObserver report before the next painted frame, and from Round 14a paint patching next to an input, under a positioned or translucent ancestor, on a motion value and on an svg among the things gpuix now does.
scripts/footprint.tsx no longer samples the frontmost app or reports a key share: in --window mode the only validity check it keeps is the occluded flag.

The README memory row records headless f993d9b9 footprints only (introduction 65 MB, showcase 131 MB, introduction 192 MB after one tour with a peak of 194 MB up from 67 MB fresh, retained elements back at 744) and leaves the in-window floor and per-element cost to the next bench.

gpuix 511bebab (#68) made a border-color transition on a collapsed-table part lay out nothing and patch with the table as its unit, so the table row declares fade(['border-color'], 80) again and the collapsed-border drift entry and README gap row were removed (drift 540 to 539).

A scroll write (scrollTop, scrollTo or a bounds read) after a mutation forces a layout pass over the whole retained tree, display: none subtrees included; on gpuix 511bebab FF's pass cost ~5 us per element, about 10x the test-renderer repro, but on e591681e (round 16, #83) a layout-dirtying read costs 1 pass at 2.87 ms median on the Command Menu page and a paint-only write costs no pass, so the port still avoids writes during mount without relying on the old figure.

Since gpuix 8352e66c a forced layout (a bounds read or a scrollTop write) no longer delivers onLayout or ResizeObserver reports; they arrive with the next painted frame after its scroll events, as in Chrome, so base-ui-solid-gpuix's scroll-area and combobox were adapted and fluid hover's pick and the composer stage's pin are one frame late exactly as the source is in Chrome.

gpuix rounds a glyph origin half down in split_glyph_origin where Chrome rounds a text baseline half up, so text whose top lands exactly on a half device pixel paints its glyphs 1px above Chrome's (the showcase ThinkingSteps tile) while boxes and fills match; the port records it in drift/home.md and a README gap row and applies no workaround.

After Round 15a the drift total rose from 540 to 541 without any gpuix change: a new port-choice entry in drift/home.md records the bento Sidebar sample person renamed 'Com Truise', while removing the Command Menu demo's three port-only cards closed no entry.

The round-16 contentVisibility variant (branch cull-cv) was rejected, not merged: entering the Command Menu page took 8 layout passes against 2, and gpuix builds a hidden subtree for any geometry read, where a display: none box answers empty.

gpuix c6475390 (Round 14a) leaves a looping animation that draws nothing (off screen, display none or stopped) costing about 3.5% CPU per loop through GpuixView::dormant_tick, which the port cannot remove; the port's onScreen gates did not help and were deleted, and layout loops (the word roll on top, the fluid-hover cursor, the carousel-dots fill on width) remain whole frames.

Input to an idle window did not wake JS on the wake-driven frame loop on gpuix c6475390 (gpuix #77), so a page that stops ticking, such as the Command Menu about 4 s after entry, lagged until the app was switched away and back; gpuix 6f2a72d3 (#93) fixes it with a kCFRunLoopBeforeWaiting observer on the event thread that posts a no-op block to the main queue, and FF changed nothing but the pin.
